title: Zephyrine and the Extraction
author: J. M. Whitlock
blurb: Xanthe Brightwater, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
